extracted.intended_audience: general readers and writers seeking information on John Truby and his screenwriting theory (screenwriters, writing students, instructors)
extracted.subtask_description: A short biographical overview of John Truby highlighting his approach to story structure (his critique of the three-act paradigm and his 22-step Anatomy of Story). Useful for writers and teachers looking for alternatives to traditional three-act structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critique of Syd Field's three-act 'Paradigm'
rubrics_metrics.description: Truby is critical of Syd Field's three-act 'Paradigm', viewing it as a mechanical means of storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer approaches that avoid purely mechanical application of a three-act template; be cautious of relying on simple act breaks as the sole organizing principle for story. The page implies that mechanical adherence to a paradigm can limit deeper structural and moral considerations in storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on moral effect of characters' actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Truby argues that most teachers of screenwriting emphasize inner transformation of characters but not the moral effect their actions have on others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating or crafting stories, consider not only a character's inner change but also how their actions affect other characters and the story's moral consequences. Strong storytelling should integrate character transformation with its ethical or social impact on others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Truby's 22-step outline (Anatomy of Story)
rubrics_metrics.description: Truby crafted his own 22-step outline, which formed the basis of his book The Anatomy of Story: 22 Steps to Becoming a Master Storyteller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt a more detailed multi-step structural approach (Truby's 22 steps) as an alternative to simpler paradigms; the outline is intended as a comprehensive framework for building story rather than a mechanical template. The page notes this outline underpins his teaching and Masterclasses.
